acceptance_meaning: The complete scientific result and INTERPRETATION are consistent with the sealed evidence; this is not candidate quality approval, a causal interaction finding, or a successful framework.

scope.checks: Compared the sealed macro/domain F1, domain-end and final differences, scalar per-ID change directions, quality decision, complete weight/package accounting, five resource windows, process cost and interpretation boundaries. Existing source and hardware-boundary reviews supplied context; this review did not repeat their execution.
scope.independence_limit: The reviewer authored the compact worker and allocation helper earlier. This is a scientific interpretation review, not an independent reproduction of their model execution.

supported_interpretation: On the same OLD compact carrier, the fixed equal-coordinate allocation bundle has mixed effects: final geography, finance and traffic improve over compact-wide, while natural and medical decline. The macro gain does not preserve the full parent's five domain targets.

Geography's domain-end gain over wide is 20 points, while its final gain is 5 points; a retention-only account of the final advantage is insufficient. These are domain-end observations, not pure acquisition effects.

Finance starts lower at its domain end under all-r8 but ends higher than wide, showing why final gains cannot be assigned solely to better domain-end function. Natural, geography and finance have subsequent net benefits; medical has a net decline.

No measured domain reaches its full-parent final target at its own domain boundary and later falls below it. Geography reaches and retains the target; the other measured domain-end deficits remain relevant. Medical's identical domain-end means include one higher and one lower per-ID score, so they do not establish function equality.

The result rejects sufficiency of this fixed seven-location r8 recipe for preserving answering function on this fixed compact visual carrier. It does not reject all update allocation, low-rank adaptation, compact representations or continual learning.
hardware_and_causal_boundary: Full-vision historical training used NEW RTX3090, whereas the compact arms used OLD RTX2080Ti; historical software and numerical flags are incompletely recorded. Reevaluation and CPU FP32 folding on OLD do not remove training-device confounding. Four-cell differences and their differences are descriptive for those historical recipe/device combinations, not pure representation-by-allocation effects. Neither device causation nor cancellation of unknown allocation-by-device effects is established. The allocation intervention also changes rank distribution, initialization, optimization paths and computation, not just position or FFN access.

resource_boundary.interpretation: Resource savings are real for the verified complete graph, package and five fixed 32-token windows, but quality still fails. Savings come from the compact visual carrier; redistributing training coordinates does not further shrink final weights. Logical weight storage and serialized package size remain distinct. No CPU-memory, latency, throughput or whole-distribution advantage is established.

publication_boundaries_accepted: Old unmerged all-r8 F1 and the formal full-data confirmation negative result are preserved; new folded generations do not overwrite or rescore them.

All domains and observed net losses are retained. Single-seed, repeatedly explored 20-QA domain cohorts do not establish significance, equivalence, generalization or formal strongest-baseline superiority.

The fixed recipe closes without rank/position/LR search, extra steps, bridge rescue or automatic formal confirmation. No unique interface, capacity, optimization, visual-recognition or forgetting cause is inferred.

Historical training, visual bridge fitting, teacher requests, external pretraining and current extraction/evaluation costs remain charged. This result is useful design evidence, not completion of the research goal.
